title: Validation-only learning-rate check for large dictionary heads (M >= 2048)
description: User approved (2026-11-26, 'Yes, run lr check'). Pre-registered before any run. Motivation: MSWEEP-001 / REVIEW-007 S-1 found that at Adam lr 1e-3 the training loss rises late in 15/21 M=2048 and 21/21 M=4096 sparse runs, so large-M results (and every earlier M=2048 head) are lr-conditional. VALIDATION ONLY: no ImageNetV2 (or any test) evaluation is run or read in this task. Heads (all Xavier fc, He encoder, loss CE + feature MSE only: reconstruction 1, dependency 0, coherence 0, as ABL-001 abl-mse / SEED-001 / MSWEEP-001): (a) sparse M=2048 k=512, (b) sparse M=4096 k=1024, (c) dense M=2048 k=2048 (included because sparse-vs-dense comparisons use it; the linear head is not tested). lr in {1e-3, 3e-4, 1e-4}. Levels source and L090 (q10) - the two levels used for GRID-001 tuning. Seeds 42, 43, 44 (pool splits 45k train / 5k validation; seeds 45-51 are deliberately NOT used so a later confirmatory re-test on them is not selected on its own validation splits). Everything else fixed as SEED-001: 10 epochs, batch 128, best.pt by validation top-1 then CE, cached GRID-001 features read-only. 3 heads x 3 lr x 2 levels x 3 seeds = 54 runs. New wrapper src/run_lrcheck.py (records the full per-epoch history in done.json); existing scripts unchanged; last.pt deleted. PRE-DECLARED ANALYSIS (metric: best-checkpoint validation top-1 on the 5k pool validation split; 6 cells = 2 levels x 3 seeds per head x lr; paired by cell): (1) For each head, lr* = the lr with the highest mean validation top-1. (2) Switch rule: recommend replacing 1e-3 by lr* for that head only if lr* != 1e-3 AND the paired difference A(lr*) - A(1e-3) has mean >= 0.30 pp AND is positive in >= 5 of 6 cells; otherwise keep 1e-3. Report mean, sd, paired-t 95% CI (df 5) and sign count for every lr vs 1e-3 (6 comparisons; descriptive, not a hypothesis-test family). (3) Instability, same definition as MSWEEP-001: a run is unstable if the total training loss rises by > 5% between any two consecutive epochs; also report median and max validation top-1 drop from the best epoch to epoch 10. Instability is 'resolved' at an lr if <= 1 of 6 runs is unstable. (4) Truncation flag: if the median best epoch at lr* is 10, flag that 10 epochs may be too short for that lr (a longer schedule would need its own check). (5) Sanity: the 12 lr=1e-3 cells of heads (a) and (c) repeat ABL-001 abl-mse runs with identical settings; report |val top-1 difference| vs ABL-001 done.json (GPU nondeterminism expected to be small) and check split digests match. EXPLORATORY (labeled): validation gap sparse M4096 - M2048 and sparse M2048 - dense M2048 at each lr; whether the M gap widens at lower lr. CONSEQUENCE: if any head switches lr, propose (do not run) a confirmatory ImageNetV2 re-test on seeds 45-51; that needs separate user approval. Validation top-1 of the selected checkpoint is optimistically biased (selection on the same split); the bias applies to all lr arms alike.
acceptance: task.json and ledger add predate the first run (timestamps)

54/54 runs complete with per-epoch history; split digest per seed identical across heads and lrs
Report applies the pre-registered switch rule first; exploratory results labeled; truncation and selection-optimism caveats stated
User src/ files and prior artifacts unchanged; harness.py check passes
